launcher.clipboard-desc: Access and manage your clipboard history from the launcher.
launcher.settings-annotation-tool-description: Command to run when clicking the annotate button in clipboard history. The image will be piped to this command.
launcher.settings-auto-paste-description: Automatically paste the selected clipboard item. Requires wtype.
launcher.settings-clip-preview-description: Show a preview of the clipboard content when using the >clip command.
launcher.settings-clip-wrap-text-description: Wrap text in the clipboard list instead of truncating it.
launcher.settings-clipboard-action-command-descri: Command to run. The matched text is available as $QD_CLIP (and the first capture group as $QD_CLIP_1) and is also piped on stdin. Clipboard content is untrusted; it is never interpolated into the command line.
launcher.settings-clipboard-action-pattern-descri: JavaScript regular expression matched against the clipboard text. Leave blank to match everything.
launcher.settings-clipboard-actions-section-descr: Run a command when a clipboard entry matches a pattern (like xfce4-clipman actions).
launcher.settings-clipboard-clear-on-lock-descrip: Wipe all clipboard history whenever the screen locks.
launcher.settings-clipboard-history-description: Access previously copied items from the launcher.
launcher.settings-clipboard-history-section-descr: Control how many entries are kept and how they are ordered.
launcher.settings-clipboard-ignore-pattern-descri: Delete clipboard entries whose preview matches this regular expression. Best effort: entries are removed shortly after being stored, so use a watcher command for a hard secrets boundary.
launcher.settings-clipboard-max-age-description: Drop entries older than this many days. Set to 0 to keep entries indefinitely.
launcher.settings-clipboard-max-entries-descripti: Maximum number of entries to keep. Set to 0 for unlimited.
launcher.settings-clipboard-ordering-description: Order history by most recently copied or by most frequently used.
launcher.settings-clipboard-primary-section-descr: Capture the X/Wayland PRIMARY selection (middle-click) into history.
launcher.settings-clipboard-privacy-section-descr: Limit how long entries are kept and exclude sensitive content.
launcher.settings-clipboard-watch-primary-command: Full command string passed to wl-paste for PRIMARY selection changes. (requires restart)
launcher.settings-clipboard-watch-primary-descrip: Store the PRIMARY (middle-click) selection in history, separately from the clipboard.
launcher.settings-clipboard-watch-image-descripti: Full command string passed to wl-paste for image changes. (requires restart)
launcher.settings-clipboard-watch-text-descriptio: Full command string passed to wl-paste for text changes. (requires restart)
launcher.settings-custom-launch-prefix-descriptio: Prefix commands with a custom launcher (e.g. 'runapp' for systemd integration).
launcher.settings-custom-launch-prefix-enabled-de: Use a custom prefix for launching applications instead of the default method.
launcher.settings-density-description: Adjust the size of application icons and the density of the launcher.
launcher.settings-desc: Customize the launcher's behavior and appearance.
launcher.settings-enable-session-search-descripti: Show session actions (lock, shutdown, reboot, etc.) when searching in the launcher.
launcher.settings-enable-settings-search-descript: Show settings results when searching in the launcher.
launcher.settings-grid-view-description: Display items in a grid layout instead of a list.
launcher.settings-icon-mode-description: Use native system icons instead of Tabler icons.
launcher.settings-ignore-mouse-input-description: Disable mouse interaction and scrollwheel in the launcher.
launcher.settings-overlay-layer-description: Display the launcher on the overlay layer, above fullscreen windows. When enabled, the launcher will not attach to the bar.
launcher.settings-position-description: Choose where the launcher panel appears.
launcher.settings-show-categories-description: Show category tabs for filtering applications.
launcher.settings-show-icon-background-descriptio: Show a rounded rectangle background behind icons.
launcher.settings-sort-by-usage-description: When enabled, frequently launched apps appear first in the list.
launcher.settings-terminal-command-description: Command to launch a terminal. E.g. 'kitty -e' or 'gnome-terminal --'.
launcher.settings-use-app2unit-description: Uses an alternative launch method to better manage app processes and prevent issues.
launcher.settings-view-mode-description: Choose the layout for the launcher entries.
launcher.title: Launcher

location.calendar-cards-desc: Organize and enable/disable cards in the calendar panel.

location.date-time-desc: Customize how date and time appear.

location.weather-fahrenheit-description: Display temperature in Fahrenheit instead of Celsius.
location.weather-hide-city-description: Hide the city name from weather displays throughout the interface.
location.weather-hide-timezone-description: Hide the timezone abbreviation from weather displays throughout the interface.
location.weather-show-effects-description: Show additional visual effects (like rain, snow, or lightning) on the weather card.
location.weather-show-in-calendar-description: Show the daily weather forecast directly in your calendar view.

lock-screen.clock-style-description: Choose the visual style of the clock on the lock screen.
lock-screen.compact-lockscreen-description: Show only the login input and system controls, hiding weather and media widgets.

lock-screen.lock-screen-tint-strength-description: Applies a tint overlay to the lock screen wallpaper.

mouse.title: Mouse & Touchpad
mouse.doubleclick-note: Double-click timing and drag thresholds are UI-interaction preferences applied by toolkits (GTK/Qt) rather than libinput; qdshell saves them, but the pointer backend does not apply them live.
mouse.backend-persist-only: The active compositor is not advertising qdshell's live pointer-config request. Your choices are saved and the supported global fields will apply automatically once the backend is available.
mouse.live-fields-note: Live pointer apply is available for global pointer speed, acceleration profile, natural scrolling, scroll method, tap to click, disable-while-typing, left-handed mode, and middle-click emulation. Controls marked below are saved only.
mouse.no-devices-description: No mice, touchpads, or trackpoints could be enumerated. The backend may be unavailable or lack the required permissions.
mouse.accel-profile-description: How pointer movement scales with speed. Adaptive accelerates with faster motion; Flat uses a constant ratio.
mouse.left-handed-description: Swap the left and right mouse buttons.
mouse.natural-scroll-description: Reverse the scroll direction so content follows finger/wheel movement.
mouse.horizontal-scroll-description: Enable horizontal scrolling where the device supports it.
mouse.horizontal-scroll-note: Note: horizontal scrolling is implicit on two-finger touchpads under the current backend; this preference is saved for backends that expose an explicit toggle.
mouse.scroll-method-description: How scrolling is triggered on touchpads.
mouse.tap-to-click-description: Register a tap on the touchpad as a click.
mouse.disable-while-typing-description: Temporarily disable the touchpad while typing to avoid accidental input.
mouse.double-click-time-description: Maximum interval between two clicks to count as a double-click.
mouse.double-click-distance-description: Maximum pointer movement between two clicks to count as a double-click.
mouse.drag-threshold-description: Distance the pointer must move before a press becomes a drag.
mouse.cursor-hint: Cursor theme and size are configured in the Appearance tab.
mouse.click-method-description: How clicks are produced on a clickpad. Button areas split the bottom edge into left/middle/right zones; Clickfinger uses one, two, or three fingers for left, middle, and right.
mouse.click-method-note: Click method is saved only; the current qdwin pointer request does not carry it.
mouse.middle-click-emulation-description: Synthesize a middle click when the left and right buttons are pressed together.
mouse.per-device-description: Override the global pointer settings for an individual device. These per-device choices are saved only; the current qdwin pointer request applies one global policy to every device.
mouse.device-enabled-description: Disable a device to ignore its input entirely.
mouse.device-customize-description: Use settings specific to this device instead of the global defaults.
mouse.tablet-description: Map the tablet's drawing area to a screen. Tablet mapping is saved only; the current qdwin pointer request does not carry tablet configuration.
mouse.no-tablet-description: Connect a tablet or stylus device to configure area mapping.
mouse.tablet-output-description: Which display the tablet area maps to. "All outputs" spans the whole desktop.
mouse.tablet-aspect-description: Keep the tablet's aspect ratio (letterboxing the area) or stretch it to fill the output.
mouse.tablet-area-x-description: Left edge of the active tablet area, as a percentage of the surface.
mouse.tablet-area-y-description: Top edge of the active tablet area, as a percentage of the surface.
mouse.tablet-area-w-description: Width of the active tablet area, as a percentage of the surface.
mouse.tablet-area-h-description: Height of the active tablet area, as a percentage of the surface.

network.bluetooth-rssi-polling-description: Periodically sample RSSI for connected devices via bluetoothctl. May not be available for all devices; uses minimal resources when enabled.

notifications.sounds-excluded-apps-description: Skip playing the configured notification sound for specific applications that have their own built-in sounds.
notifications.sounds-files-critical-description: Path to the sound file played for critical priority notifications.
notifications.sounds-files-desc: Configure custom sound files for different notification urgency levels.
notifications.sounds-files-low-description: Path to the sound file played for low priority notifications.
notifications.sounds-files-normal-description: Path to the sound file played for normal priority notifications.
notifications.sounds-files-unified-description: Path to the sound file played for notifications.
notifications.sounds-separate-description: Use different sound files for low, normal, and critical priority notifications.

notifications.sounds-volume-description: Adjust the volume level for notification sounds.
notifications.toast-battery-description: Show a warning when the battery level falls below this percentage.
notifications.toast-keyboard-description: Show a toast when the keyboard layout changes.
notifications.toast-media-description: Show a toast when media playback state changes.
notifications.suppress-duplicates-description: Automatically suppress identical notifications received within a short time window.
notifications.suppress-duplicates-window-description: Time window (in seconds) during which duplicate notifications are suppressed.
notifications.app-policy-desc: Configure notification behavior per application. Apps appear here after sending their first notification.
notifications.app-policy-muted-description: Suppress visual notification popups from this app.
notifications.app-policy-allow-urgent-description: Still show critical/urgent notifications even when muted.
notifications.app-policy-log-description: Record notifications from this app in the notification log.
notifications.app-policy-empty: No apps have sent notifications yet
notifications.app-policy-empty-desc: Per-app policies will appear here once apps start sending notifications.

removable-media.enabled-description: Detect USB sticks, SD cards and external disks; show notifications and offer to mount them.

power.power-button-action-description: Action when the power button is pressed

power.lid-ignore-external-label: Don't sleep when external display connected

power.display-off-ac-description: Minutes of inactivity before turning the display off while plugged in (0 to disable)
power.display-brightness-hint: For per-monitor brightness sliders, see the Display tab.
power.presentation-mode-description: Prevent the screen from blanking, sleeping or dimming while presenting
power.presentation-auto-disable-description: Automatically turn presentation mode off after this many minutes (0 = never)
power.inhibit-fullscreen-label: Inhibit when an application is fullscreen
power.inhibit-fullscreen-description: Prevent idle/sleep while a window is in fullscreen (e.g. video, games)
power.inhibit-fullscreen-persist-only: qdwin does not yet expose a fullscreen-window signal, so this preference is saved but not yet enforced. It will take effect automatically once support is added.
power.disable-notifications-inhibited-descript: Suppress notification popups while idle is inhibited (e.g. during presentation mode)
power.auto-reduce-brightness-description: Automatically dim the display when running on battery and restore on AC
power.ac-brightness-level-description: Display brightness level when plugged in
power.battery-brightness-level-description: Reduced display brightness level when on battery
power.brightness-persist-only: No controllable backlight was detected on this machine, so these levels are saved but cannot be applied here.

vmApps.title: Sandboxed VM apps
vmApps.intro: Tier-5 apps each run in their own disposable virtual machine. These options control how that VM is shut down when the app closes. Tier-5 is experimental.
vmApps.method-description: How a VM is torn down when its app exits. Graceful asks the guest to power off cleanly via the ACPI power button before forcing it off; Force destroys it immediately.
vmApps.grace-description: How long to wait for a graceful shutdown to finish before forcing the VM off.
vmApps.idle-description: Keep a VM running this long after its app closes, then shut it down. 0 shuts it down immediately. (No relaunch reuse yet — this is a shutdown delay.)
vmApps.lowmem-label: Shut down idle VMs under low memory
vmApps.lowmem-description: When free system memory drops below this amount, shut idle VMs down right away instead of waiting for the idle timeout. 0 disables this.
vmApps.perapp-intro: Override the defaults above for individual apps. Apps without an override use the global settings.

window-manager.title: Window Manager
window-manager.backend-persist-only: The active compositor (qdwin) does not yet accept window-manager policy from qdshell — its IPC has no window-manager request yet. Your choices are saved and will be applied automatically once qdwin gains support.
window-manager.focus-policy-description: How a window gains keyboard focus.
window-manager.ffm-delay-description: Time the pointer must rest over a window before it takes focus.
window-manager.raise-on-click-description: Bring a window to the front when it is clicked.
window-manager.raise-on-hover-description: Bring a window to the front when the pointer hovers over it.
window-manager.snap-enabled-description: Snap windows to screen edges and other windows, and tile when dragged to an edge.
window-manager.snap-distance-description: How close to an edge a window must be dragged before it snaps.
window-manager.titlebar-double-click-description: Action when the titlebar is double-clicked.
window-manager.decoration-theme-description: Name of the decoration theme to apply to window titlebars and borders.
window-manager.shortcuts-note: Window-manager shortcuts are accelerator strings (e.g. Super+Left). They are saved now and will be applied once qdwin supports window-manager policy.
window-manager.shortcut-close-description: Shortcut to close the focused window.
window-manager.shortcut-maximize-description: Shortcut to maximize or restore the focused window.
window-manager.shortcut-fullscreen-description: Shortcut to toggle fullscreen for the focused window.
window-manager.shortcut-tile-left-description: Shortcut to tile the focused window to the left half of the screen.
window-manager.shortcut-tile-right-description: Shortcut to tile the focused window to the right half of the screen.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.capability-note: This session has no live keyboard backend (the Wayland compositor owns key repeat and layout). Settings are saved and will apply when a supporting backend is available or under an X11/Xwayland session.
keyboard.use-system-defaults-description: When on, qdshell does not override the keyboard layout, variants or XKB options and leaves them to the system. Key repeat, cursor blink and NumLock stay editable.
keyboard.repeat-delay-description: How long a key must be held before it starts repeating.
keyboard.repeat-rate-description: How many times per second a held key repeats.
keyboard.test-area-description: Type here to feel the repeat and cursor blink settings.
keyboard.test-area-placeholder: Type to test repeat and blink…
keyboard.cursor-blink-description: Enable blinking of the text cursor.
keyboard.cursor-persist-note: Cursor blink preferences are persisted for use by a session settings daemon; qdshell does not apply them to GTK/Qt applications directly yet.
keyboard.restore-numlock-description: Turn NumLock on when the session starts.
keyboard.model-description: Physical keyboard model used for the XKB mapping.
keyboard.layouts-description: Add, reorder, and remove keyboard layouts. The first layout is used by default; use the switching shortcut to cycle between them.
keyboard.switch-shortcut-description: Key combination to cycle between configured layouts.
keyboard.compose-key-description: Key that starts a Compose sequence for typing special characters.
keyboard.xkb-caps-escape: Make Caps Lock an additional Escape
keyboard.xkb-altwin-menu: Alt+Win behaves like the Menu key
keyboard.shortcuts-capability-note: Global hotkeys are owned by the qdwin compositor, which does not yet expose a way to bind them. These shortcuts are saved and will take effect once qdwin supports applying them. The navigation keybinds below are handled directly by qdshell.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-description: Bind a key combination to a command. Commands run directly (no shell), so characters like ; | & are passed literally and cannot chain extra commands.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-empty: No custom shortcuts yet. Add one below.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-command-description: Program to launch with its arguments. Run as an argument vector, never via a shell.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-conflict: This combination conflicts with another shortcut.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-incomplete-description: A custom shortcut needs both a key combination and a command.
keyboard.custom-shortcuts-shell-description: Custom shortcuts cannot invoke a shell with -c (e.g. sh -c ...). Enter the program and its arguments directly instead.
